name: EWA World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Created for the federation's own debut pay-per-view, an eight-man tournament that crowned its first champion in the tournament final.
notes: Contested in an eight-man single-elimination tournament across the promotion's debut pay-per-view, 28 September 2003.

name: EWA Intercontinental Championship
epitaph: Announced by the federation's own president on 30 September 2003 as a new second title, first won four weeks later at the promotion's second pay-per-view.
notes: The federation's president announced the title's creation on 30 September 2003 and named "Crippler" Evan Crowley and Tommy Starr as its first challengers; the surviving record's own next dated document showing the two men fighting for the belt is the 26 October 2003 pay-per-view, which the ring announcer calls for "a NEW" champion.
